verdict.rationale: Marqeta ships an official MCP Server enabling AI agents to query data, issue virtual cards, set spend controls, and conduct transaction intelligence/dispute resolution via natural language interactions, which directly supports NL command operation. However, this is scoped to a designated set of Core API endpoints via an agent intermediary rather than a native NL interface across the full product, and there's no independent/hands-on corroboration of real-world natural-language command reliability. Missing for 10: broader coverage beyond the designated endpoint subset, independent verification of NL command accuracy/reliability, and evidence of NL support outside the MCP server context.
